Operator tooling failure, not a Sentinel result: the scratch orchestrator stopped while making the throwaway TLS certificates, because the inherited OPENSSL_CONF named a file that did not exist (openssl req exited 1). Its own record shows it created no RBAC, container or volume and injected no fault; the only Sentinel step that ran was a kind_bundle restore that found the target already healthy at baseline (0.3 s, generation unchanged at 184), and a scan of its files found no credential. Rerun at the same revision with a private openssl.cnf as worker-container-planner-be6e636-20261112t181036z.

Harness failure, not a Sentinel result: pair shipping-config+cart-pod applied both faults within 0.3 s and the Observer opened an incident for each target, then the harness stopped with ValueError 'Unknown Boutique observation stage', because runtime/boutique_observability.py did not accept the pair-fault stage of the storefront journal (the offline pair tests had mocked the journal). No proposal was planned, so there was no Guard decision and no Executor write. The chaos object's cleanup was confirmed and the administrator's emergency restore returned the configuration-faulted service, shippingservice, to its baseline. Fixed in 1941683 (merged in 02d91e5); the pair runs were repeated at dca7369 (C-DUAL-FAULT-PAIRS-DCA7369). No evidence class for pair runs exists in the collector at this revision, so the run folder (FAILED summary) stays local.
